scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @blink/api & npm run dev -w @blink/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blink/shared && npm run build -w @blink/api && npm run build -w @blink/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @blink/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @blink/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blink/shared && npm run typecheck -w @blink/api && npm run typecheck -w @blink/web
